title: CURATRON: Complete and Robust Preference Data for Rigorous Alignment of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and algorithmic aspects of preference learning and data curation (robust PCA, ranking algorithms) to improve the robustness of LLM alignment. While it mentions the goal of 'ethically aligned AI' and human values as the target of alignment, it does not evaluate specific religious, moral, or ethical frameworks or dilemmas.
